notes.title: Alpha 1.2 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hey all, just a small patch tonight for our Alpha 1 playtesters. This alpha will wrap up shortly and we'll go into development mode and come back swinging with Alpha 2 (soon!).

[h1]Alpha 1.2 Patchnotes[/h1]

[h3]RESOURCES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tool repair effect reduced from +10 HP/tool to +8 HP/tool
[/list]
[h3]BATTLES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased difficult of late-game battles, increased number of spawned ships
[/list]
[h3]HUD[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added animation when Saving game
[/list]
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clinic: a healing doctor is now killed correctly when building is destroyed
[*] Clinic: now sends patients home if there's no path to City Hall 
[*] Repair Shop: repair button is no longer disable and you can repair this building
[*] UI: Fixed issue with title, settings, and map setup screen overlapping each other and leaving buttons clickable
[*] UI: "Escape" key now closes Pause/Settings menu while in game
[*] Enabling Bulldoze mode will now cancel building or road placement
[/list]


Be sure to [url=http://eepurl.com/g-pYJX]Sign Up if you'd like to test![/url]

notes.title: Thank you for your feedback during Closed Alpha 1!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you everyone[/b] for all of your feedback during Alpha 1 testing! Developing a city building survival game has proved incredibly challenging, so feedback directly from players like you provides [i]IMMENSE insight [/i]our little team. THANK YOU.

[url=http://eepurl.com/g-pYJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38554651/7db895cbf2929ef9112262e63ad02e66331acdf6.png[/img][/url]
If you're not a part of the current Closed Alpha, be sure to [b][url=http://eepurl.com/g-pYJX]SIGN UP[/url][/b] for the next round! We will regularly be hosting them as we march towards release.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/PsdyUY5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38554651/1864f7bd30935d56d0e69e6461bb1c36c2d75979.png[/img][/url]
[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/PsdyUY5]Join our Discord[/url][/b] if you want to hang out! We love talking about game design & development.

I've updated the build to Alpha 1 Patch 1. Read the patch notes below:

[h1]Alpha 1.1 Patchnotes[/h1]
[h3]SETTLEMENT[/h3]
[b]Guardtower[/b]
- added weapon to worker hand
- improved feedback with added shot vfx/sfx
[b]Laser Platform[/b]
- build cost changed from 5 Ore 15 Lumber to 5 Fuel 15 Lumber
- fire delay increased from 4s to 5s
[b]Repair[/b]
- build cost changed from 20 Lumber to 20 Fuel
[b]Refinery[/b]
- increased ResourcesPerHourPerWorker from 0.43 to 0.53
[b]Airfield[/b]
- updated building description
[b]Cyberwarfare Center[/b]
- updated building description
[b]Launch Facility[/b]
- updated building description
 
[h3]RESOURCES[/h3]
- Ore deposits now have infinite resources and do not deplete
- Oil fields now have infinite resources and do not deplete 
- Tool repair effect doubled from +5 HP/tool to +10 HP/tool

[h3]BATTLES[/h3]
- Early-game alien ship count decreased
- Late-game alien ship count increased

[h3]ABILITIES[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38554651/49d840a7411e975bc5e54c2966bb050a0efd4803.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38554651/bcb96696b3c231358875e66b2bd23f29d58e57ec.png[/img][/url]
[b]Militia[/b]
- added lifetime progress bar to show ability duration
- improved vfx/sfx feedback
 
[h3]CAMERA[/h3]
- Max Zoom increased from 4000 to 6000

[h3]HUD[/h3]
- Updated build button icon
- Updated battle ability tooltips to more accurately describe effect
- Battle ability button tooltips can now be viewed even if ability is locked
